reason: A DeepSeek Harness channel plugin that connects QQ Bot Gateway conversations to persistent Harness agents, supporting text, media, approvals, agent tools, and controlled workspace file delivery.

summaries.zh: 将腾讯官方 QQ Bot Gateway 接入 DeepSeek Harness，使 QQ 私聊和群聊能够使用持久化智能体会话、文本与媒体消息、审批交互及受控工作区文件发送。
summaries.en: Connects the official QQ Bot Gateway to persistent DeepSeek Harness agent sessions with text and media messaging, approval interactions, and controlled workspace file delivery.

capabilities: Connects to the official Tencent QQ Bot Gateway
Receives C2C and group text messages, images, voice transcripts, and attachment metadata
Sends assistant text, images, and workspace files to QQ conversations
Maintains persistent Harness sessions per QQ conversation
Invokes Harness agent tools and handles requester-bound approval prompts
Reads local workspace files subject to configured containment and size checks
